meta.name: الغاء قفل رئيسي | Unlock My Boss
meta.description:
سيون جو، مدير تنفيذي عبقري يبلغ من العمر 39 عامًا، توفي بشكل غامض وأصبحت روحه عالقة في هاتف ذكي.

The 39-year-old Seon Ju, a genius CEO of a large corporation who accidentally died and became a smartphone, and In Seong, a 29-year-old job seeker who accidentally picked up the smartphone, work together to find the killer.
